$comment: Schema v4. The unit is a BEAT, not a scene. A beat may be shorter than the clip it comes from, may not be generated at all, and always carries its own on-screen text and voiceover line. The beat list is the timeline.

beats.description: The reel in order. Every beat has text and a voiceover line; only generated beats have a scene prompt.

id.description: One of: hook, problem, intro, demo, payoff, cta

source.description: generated = written by you and produced by the video model. app_recording = real captured app footage. end_card = a designed card. You write scene_prompt only for generated beats.

use_seconds.description: How long this beat is on screen in the final cut. Short. 2 to 3 seconds for story beats.

generate_seconds.description: Only for generated beats: the clip length to request, from 4, 6 or 8. Always longer than use_seconds - the clip is trimmed to its best moment.

scene_prompt.description: Only for generated beats. 60-150 words, ordered subject, action, setting, camera, lighting, colour, audio. No speech: the voiceover is a separate track.

on_screen_text.description: Composited afterwards, never rendered by the video model. At most 7 words. Must carry the beat's meaning with the sound off. Empty string only if the beat genuinely needs none.

voiceover.description: One spoken line for this beat, part of a single continuous narration across the whole reel. Read at roughly 2.5 words per second, so a 3 second beat holds about 8 words.

caption.description: Post caption. First line is the hook, under 125 characters, alone on its line. Ends with the supplied keyword CTA. No hashtags.

hashtags.description: Exactly 8 lowercase hashtags without the # symbol.

alt_text.description: One sentence describing the visual, for accessibility and the Facebook post.

dials_used.description: Echo of the dial ids received in the input, verified programmatically.

uniqueness_rationale.description: One sentence naming the specific dials that differentiate this post from the recent posts supplied.

dial_conflict.description: Empty string if the dial combination worked. Otherwise name the dial and why it fought the topic.
